convergence: manual (review-loop.mjs bypassed: codex-exec lens hung this session; findings applied directly with judgment, then re-reviewed)

findings.description: peers.json out-of-band discovery fallback read as violating the Scope-A 'Dev Tunnels sole channel' constraint.
findings.resolution: Reframed: Dev Tunnels management plane (devtunnel list) is the SOLE network discovery path; peers.json is a machine-local operator-authored file (the operator's explicitly-named 'out-of-band operator-controlled path' + TOFU peer-pin store), not a third-party channel. Nothing transits phone/happy-server.

findings.description: Ingest route cannot validate X-Tunnel-Authorization because the Dev Tunnels gateway strips it before reaching happy-server (happy-server/AGENTS.md).
findings.resolution: Backend-observable auth is now app-layer only: Ed25519 detached signature over the envelope verified against a TOFU-pinned peer machineKey + sealed-box decrypt; tunnel-gateway connect-token auth is enforced at the gateway and not re-checked at the backend.

findings.description: Scope B/C/spawn stories depend on the async-events substrate that is not in this checkout; the dependency was only an optional open question.
findings.resolution: Added 'External Dependency: async-events-design (HARD gate)' subsection splitting stories into independent vs dependent bands; scope-bc cluster carries an externalPrereq; implement-with-ralph must confirm mailbox.ts on origin/main before scope-bc.

findings.description: createHappyServer / HappyServerConfig + happy-server.d.ts have no injection callback slot for the ingest->mailbox handler.
findings.resolution: Added an agentCommsIngest callback slot to HappyServerConfig + the CLI declaration shim to Files-to-Modify and the Scope A AC; US-006 owns it.

findings.description: spawnSessionFromSession.ts omits initialMessage; fix may need SpawnSessionOptions/registerCommonHandlers extension.
findings.resolution: Files-to-Modify now requires verifying the full initialMessage chain (RpcOptions -> deps -> SpawnSessionOptions -> registerCommonHandlers) and extending whichever hop drops it.

findings.description: scope-bc dependsOn omitted the explicit async-events edge; scope-a should start after router public types stable.
findings.resolution: Added externalPrereq to scope-bc and a 'start after core router public types stable' rationale to scope-a in suggested-decomposition.json.

findings.description: happy-wire export wiring under-specified; 'manual two-machine smoke' vague; typecheck command unnamed.
findings.resolution: ACs now require AgentCommsEnvelope export from happy-wire/src/index.ts, an exact 'Manual two-machine smoke' doc section (commands + JSON + curl + non-goals), and named build/test commands (npm_config_script_shell=bash pnpm --filter happy test; pnpm --filter happy-server build).

findings.description: Plan may overreach (peerAuth, peerTransport, ingest, tunnel discovery, unified send, spawn, doc) in one pass.
findings.resolution: Acknowledged in Open Questions: Scope A is interfaces+tests+design only this pass; the decomposition split allows landing the async-events-independent band first. Kept full design per operator intent.

findings.description: Round 2: Scope A app-layer crypto referenced the credentials 'machineKey'; the codebase has dedicated TOFU keypairs (tofu/keypairManager.ts: Ed25519 server-key + ECDH ecdh-key). Wrong key surface would break signature/decrypt wiring.
findings.resolution: Rewrote Scope A step 3 + Risk + AC to require peerAuth.ts use TofuKeypairs (Ed25519 server-key sign + ECDH ecdh-key seal) and pin peer TOFU public keys (ed25519Fingerprint + ecdh pub), NOT machineKey. Verified against keypairManager.ts:13-38.

findings.description: Round 2: initialMessage path not represented in the target spawn type; SpawnSessionOptions (registerCommonHandlers.ts:120-131) lacks initialMessage and spawnSessionFromSession.ts:126-134 drops it. 'extend whichever hop drops it' was too vague.
findings.resolution: Files-to-Modify now explicitly: add initialMessage?: string to SpawnSessionOptions + pass options.config.initialMessage through deps.spawnSession. Verified both gaps against the actual files.

findings.description: Round 2: decomposition contradicted the plan — initialMessage fix called async-events-independent but all of US-005 was in the gated scope-bc cluster.
findings.resolution: Split US-005 into US-005a (initialMessage fix, new independent 'spawn-initmsg' phase-1 cluster) and US-005b (Scope C reference+fixture, scope-bc, async-events-gated). Updated Preliminary Story Decomposition, External Dependency bands, and suggested-decomposition.json (scope-bc dependsOn now includes spawn-initmsg).
